data.long_meaning: In Hungarian, Minta means 'gift'. It is a popular name in Hungary and is often given to newborn girls. The name conveys the idea of a precious gift from God. The name Minta carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Minta usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minta total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
